observation: Stages 1-3 are healthy: recentre residual 2.4 cm (gate 10 cm), orient_axis_corr 0.94 with invariant OK, depth NaN 22.3% (family-normal for complex 4-x), denoise retention 0.76 with spatially uniform discards. Detection is where coherence breaks: the outlier map yields 10 Hough verticals for 10 rings (ring_count_error 0), but only 5 oblique segments were found (3 positive-slope, 2-3 negative) across a 4700x3600 px map, so det_real_detection_ratio is 0.4 and 6/10 prompt centres are 'assume' fallbacks alternating between y~1120 and y~1550. The horizontal fallback (blue) fires in many rings. The SC overlay shows most label boundaries unsupported (red) and many joint lines unexplained (orange); correspondence_f1@15 is only 0.225 while sam_segment_size_cv is 1.06. The sam_depth_input clearly shows oblique segment joints in most rings, but the binarised outlier map shows them as faint, broken traces dominated by bolt-hole chevrons.
rule: Ontology d7 (m_line_yield low AND horizontal fallback triggered) -> f_missing_lines; upstream suspect f_joint_oversmoothed (joint contrast low in outlier map). Remediation r_relax_hough: lower oblique Hough threshold / raise maxLineGap, and lower the binarisation threshold so faint joint pixels survive. Tuning order (experiences §7) says stages 1-3 are already validated, so round 1 is spent on detection, keeping vertical count and SAM geometry fixed.
failure_mode: stage_4_detection.f_missing_lines (with partial f_pattern_mismatch: real intersections that are found do not all pass the K/AB distance pattern, so the pipeline falls back to assumed centres)
rationale: Coordinated detection-only overlay. binary_threshold 127->110 lets fainter joint pixels through binarisation before dilation. hough_threshold_oblique 50->35 and maxLineGap_oblique 50->70 accept the broken oblique joint traces as single lines. hough_threshold_horizontal 50->40 keeps the horizontal fallback reliable where oblique still fails. pattern_tolerance raised to 15 px so real intersections that are a few pixels off the K/AB pattern are kept instead of replaced by 'assume' points. hough_threshold_vertical is left untouched because the vertical count already equals ring_count (10/10). Denoising, enhancing and SAM keys are left at anchor values to attribute any proxy delta to detection; SAM geometry will be revisited in later rounds only if per-block coherence (fill rate, size CV) is the remaining weak feature.
